before: The caret walked through the characters of a content-locked inline control.
after: With lockedControlNavigation set to atomic, keyboard motions and engine pointer gestures treat a content-locked inline control as one unit. Without the option, behavior is unchanged.
reason: The option changes only local caret placement and selection. It adds no operation and writes no shared state; a selection over a control is published as an ordinary range, and layout publishes the control's model range as derived, unshared data.
